description: This file contains functions for generating a TDS computation summary report in an ERP system, including data validation, grouping, and column configuration.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to execute the report, validating filters, fetching data, and returning columns and results.

methods.name: validate_filters
methods.description: Validates that date filters are properly set and within the same fiscal year.

methods.name: group_by_supplier_and_category
methods.description: Groups data by supplier and section code, aggregating total credited amount and TDS deducted.

methods.name: get_final_result
methods.description: Converts the grouped dictionary into a list of result dictionaries.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report based on filters.
